summary: This run widened the tracked market beyond the obvious inline-converter clones. The biggest update is not a pricing change. It is the clearer pattern that revenue in this space goes to products with trust, onboarding, and a stronger commercial frame than FX Inline currently has. New additions include Rapid Currency Converter, Currency Converter PRO, Shopify localization substitutes, and a fresh Converter.app extension launch.

notable_changes.change: Current Chrome snippet still shows a weak commercial profile: roughly mid-300 users, 21 ratings, and a 2.0 rating while the site still sells a lifetime premium.
Firefox listing now surfaces 720 users and 74 reviews, and review snippets still complain about setup complexity, wrong values, and CPU or memory overload.
Firefox listing now shows 11 users and 5 reviews, and the public API-key criticism is still visible in review text.
FX Inline public marketplace metadata remains inconsistent with repo source and generated artifact versions, which is now a serious trust liability.

newly_relevant_products_or_launches.why_it_matters: Fresh Reddit launch activity on April 16 and April 17, 2026 shows new entrants still see this category as open, and the launch is tied to a broader converter platform rather than a standalone extension.

competitors_reviewed.traction: Chrome store snippet showed roughly 60,000 users and a 4.8 rating
competitors_reviewed.pricing_model: Freemium with 7.95 USD/month Extension Pro and paid credit packs
competitors_reviewed.why_it_matters: Best current proof that browser-based currency conversion can be monetized seriously.

competitors_reviewed.traction: Chrome listing showed 40,000 users and 1.5K ratings at 3.6
competitors_reviewed.why_it_matters: Large incumbent with middling ratings proves that feature breadth alone does not create love.

competitors_reviewed.traction: About 6,000 Chrome users plus 720 Firefox users
competitors_reviewed.why_it_matters: Reviews reveal the accuracy, setup, and performance problems buyers punish.

competitors_reviewed.traction: 875 Chrome users and 83 ratings, plus 188 Firefox users and 28 reviews
competitors_reviewed.pricing_model: Free with optional external API-key path
competitors_reviewed.why_it_matters: Strong browsing-centric controls create ideas worth copying, but settings friction remains a warning.

competitors_reviewed.traction: Roughly mid-300 Chrome users and 21 ratings at 2.0
competitors_reviewed.why_it_matters: Monetization proof plus a warning that weak trust and weak ratings poison monetization.
Shows there is still room for small entrants that package the value around shopper convenience.

competitors_reviewed.traction: Official site was visible; no strong public traction signal verified this run
competitors_reviewed.why_it_matters: Its onboarding story is stronger than FX Inline's current site even without obvious monetization.
Tiny scale but sharp review signals around security and missing currency support.
Proves that privacy-first positioning and a hybrid auto-plus-manual model resonate even at low scale.
Brand strength does not rescue weak default UX.
Strong ratings and a clean general utility can win the same install intent FX Inline hopes to capture.

competitors_reviewed.traction: Shopify App Store shows 4.6 from 406 reviews and 29 USD/month pricing
competitors_reviewed.pricing_model: Paid monthly app with free trial
competitors_reviewed.why_it_matters: Strong proof that merchants pay for localization when it clearly improves international pricing display.

competitors_reviewed.traction: Shopify App Store shows 4.5 from roughly 146 reviews with a free entry tier
competitors_reviewed.pricing_model: Free entry tier with broader localization offer
competitors_reviewed.why_it_matters: Competes for merchant budget and highlights the importance of mobile compatibility and support.
Validates B2B willingness to pay for currency infrastructure.

competitors_reviewed.traction: Global brand with active partner programs
competitors_reviewed.why_it_matters: Validates creator and affiliate monetization if traffic ever exists.
Validates travel-intent monetization, but also shows how far FX Inline is from having a traffic engine.

competitors_reviewed.traction: Fresh Reddit launch activity on April 16 and April 17, 2026; public traction not yet verified
competitors_reviewed.pricing_model: Likely free extension tied to a broader converter.app platform
competitors_reviewed.why_it_matters: Shows that broader-platform cross-sell may be a more viable angle than a naked standalone utility.
